none: PAS FindID 986827: Roman coin : Republican denarius struck by Sextus Pompeius
contea di ritrovamento: Hampshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman Republican silver denarius struck in 137 BC by the moneyer Sextus Pompeius (Reece period 1), FOSTLVS; SEX POM; ROMA reverse type depicting she-wolf, right, suckling twins; behind, tree (ficus Ruminalis), with one bird perching on trunk [and two birds perching on upper branches]; on left, Faustulus, identified by inscription; on right, inscription; in exergue, inscription. Mint of Rome. Reference: RRC 235/1
